name: Stolen Booty
summary: Stolen Booty concludes Gazlowe's effort to reclaim valuable cargo hijacked by the Southsea Freebooters off the coast of Ratchet. Rather than trying to recover every lost crate, the goblin chief focuses on two essential items: a shipment of cobbler's boots and a delicate telescopic lens needed to complete his observatory.

sections.title: Pirate Hijacking
sections.body: The Southsea Freebooters have long plagued the merchant lanes of the Great Sea, but establishing a fortified encampment just south of Ratchet brought them into direct conflict with Gazlowe. When merchant vessels heading for the port were intercepted and looted, the Steamwheedle Cartel lost considerable supplies. While low-priority goods could be written off as routine shipping hazards, high-value specialized merchandise warranted hiring mercenary muscle to break into the pirate stronghold.

sections.title: The Missing Pieces
sections.body: Gazlowe's priorities were intensely practical. One item was an essential shipment of boots dispatched from Drizzlik down in Booty Bay, badly needed by local laborers. The other was far more specialized: a ground telescopic lens designed for the prominent observatory tower overlooking Ratchet. While its twin lens had arrived safely by overland caravan through Durotar, the seaborne half was snatched right off the water. Without it, the observatory remained an empty frame.

faq.q: Why does Gazlowe care so much about these two specific items?
faq.answer: Gazlowe acknowledges that recovering all the hijacked cargo is impossible, but the boot shipment from Drizzlik in Booty Bay and the telescopic lens are irreplaceable. The boots supply local workers, while the precision lens is required to finish the observatory overlooking Ratchet.

faq.q: Where did the two observatory lenses come from?
aliases: how did gazlowe get the lenses
faq.answer: The observatory requires two lenses to function properly. The larger lens safely arrived via an overland caravan traveling through Durotar. The smaller lens was shipped by sea, only to be intercepted when Southsea Freebooters raided the vessel off the coast of the Barrens.

Drizzlik is a goblin cobbler operating out of Booty Bay in the southern Eastern Kingdoms. He crafted and dispatched the shipment of footwear bound for Gazlowe's crews in Ratchet before pirates intercepted the cargo ship.

faq.q: Where are the stolen items hidden?
faq.answer: Both the crates of boots and the telescopic lens were stashed in the Southsea pirate encampment along the Merchant Coast, just south of Ratchet.

aliases: what is next after stolen booty
faq.answer: Stolen Booty is the final chapter in this specific Southsea pirate investigation chain. Once the items are returned, Gazlowe expresses gratitude, praises your reliability, and invites you to continue working for his commercial enterprise in Ratchet.

faq.q: Why does Ratchet have an observatory?
aliases: why does gazlowe want a telescope
faq.answer: Goblin engineering relies heavily on observation, navigation, and surveying the surrounding land and sea lanes. Completing the observatory tower allows Ratchet's leadership to monitor approaching merchant fleets, rival vessels, and encroaching threats across the Merchant Coast.

angles.text: Gazlowe's observatory project highlights goblin precision optics, showing that heavy construction and delicate glasswork must both come together to build practical coastal infrastructure.
Importing boots all the way from Drizzlik in Booty Bay demonstrates the widespread trade network for finished leather and cobbling across the Steamwheedle ports.
